## Verification

- [ ] I ran the relevant checks locally.
- [ ] The change does not introduce undocumented exported production APIs.
- [ ] Any type-safety escape, lint suppression, complexity exception, filesystem or IPC seam, and TODO/FIXME has a focused rationale or follow-up.
- [ ] A human reviewer can understand the changed contracts, invariants, trade-offs, and safety constraints from the code and nearby documentation.
- [ ] A human reviewer has confirmed that public contracts and their documentation are accurate and sufficient for the changed behavior.
- [ ] A human reviewer has confirmed that the documentation matches current behavior and does not preserve stale claims.

## Documentation impact

- [ ] For behavior changes, I assessed Current Capabilities, changelog/release notes, the Code Map, Delivery Plan acceptance/status, public tutorials, and deferred tutorial register [#57](https://github.com/tacomancy/galaxy-brain/issues/57).
- [ ] If a public tutorial changed, I updated its version/environment and repository/Adapter boundary metadata and its tutorial evidence mapping.
- [ ] If no public documentation changed, I confirmed that the change is outside the public workflow boundary or explained the deferral in the PR description.
